label: WaterTAP Mother-Liquor Recycle Crystallization
request: Build and solve a steady-state NaCl crystallizer with liquid mother-liquor recycle. Feed 10.5119 kg/s fresh NaCl and 38.9326 kg/s fresh water, operate at 328.15 K with 40% single-pass NaCl yield, recycle 80% of liquid mother liquor, and purge 20%. Exclude vapor and crystals from recycle. Report single-pass and fresh-feed overall recovery, recycle ratio, purge salt loss, heat duty, pressure-conditioning boundary, and steady-state NaCl balance closure.
